deadline.value: Decisions are made on a rolling basis; applying before February 15 is recommended for fall admission.
deadline.quote: It is recommended to submit the application before Feb 15th, for fall admission.

gre_subject.value: The department does not require the GRE.

supervisor.value: A graduate committee admits applicants on academic record, so a supervisor's agreement is not needed first.
supervisor.quote: The Graduate Committee determines who to admit and support based on academic qualifications

funding.value: All applicants are considered for support, and a graduate committee decides who is supported.
funding.quote: The Graduate Committee determines who to admit and support based on academic qualifications

entry_route.value: Admission is possible after a bachelor's (60 credits) or a master's (30 credits).

notes: Two concentrations are listed in the department's older handbook (computational and applied mathematics; discrete mathematics). The statistics PhD is saved as its own statistics record.
